monthlyUpdates.text: July was StewardRight's most intensive pre-launch month. The site went through a full home page v2 redesign, GTM was installed across 14 pages, Turnstile was added to the contact form, and individual advisor booking pages went live for Mike Proctor, Lyndon Zielke, and Bryan Looper with their own Calendly embeds. GBP tracked 12 calls ahead of full launch.
